prompt: Block UPI payments above 50k from rooted devices.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND txn.amount > 50000 AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_upi_large"

prompt: Rooted device + amount of 25 thousand or more → review.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.amount >= 25000 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_mid_amount"

prompt: 5 or more failed attempts in 24h: block.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 5 THEN BLOCK reason="repeated_failures"

prompt: Gaming merchant, over Rs 10,000, merchant not whitelisted. Send to review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND txn.amount > 10000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="gaming_untrusted_large"

prompt: International card payment above 1.5L? Block.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.method == CARD AND txn.amount > 150000 THEN BLOCK reason="intl_card_large"

prompt: Allow wallet payments under ₹500 when the merchant is whitelisted.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND txn.amount < 500 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="small_wallet_trusted"

prompt: More than 8 payments in the last hour from one user, block it.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 8 THEN BLOCK reason="velocity_spike"

prompt: Device first seen less than 2 days ago and amount over 20k: review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 2 AND txn.amount > 20000 THEN REVIEW reason="fresh_device_large"

prompt: Block when KYC isn't done and the amount is above 10 thousand.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount > 10000 THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_large"

prompt: Netbanking at 11pm or later with amount over 1 lakh, block.
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND txn.hour >= 23 AND txn.amount > 100000 THEN BLOCK reason="late_netbanking_large"

prompt: Travel or electronics merchant, amount above 75k, and account younger than 30 days. Review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, ELECTRONICS] AND txn.amount > 75000 AND user.account_age_days < 30 THEN REVIEW reason="young_account_big_ticket"

prompt: Anything before 5am on a rooted device gets blocked.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 5 AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="night_rooted"

prompt: Review if (3+ failed attempts OR rooted device) AND amount > 40k.
rule: WHEN (user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3 OR device.is_rooted) AND txn.amount > 40000 THEN REVIEW reason="risky_signal_large"

prompt: Whitelisted grocery under 5000, KYC verified: let it through.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND merchant.category == GROCERY AND txn.amount < 5000 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="trusted_grocery_small"

prompt: Non-UPI payments over 2 lakh need review.
rule: WHEN txn.method != UPI AND txn.amount > 200000 THEN REVIEW reason="non_upi_large"

prompt: Block international payments from accounts under 7 days old.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.account_age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="intl_new_account"

prompt: Food merchant: if more than 5 payments in an hour, review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == FOOD AND txn.count_1h > 5 THEN REVIEW reason="food_velocity"

prompt: Amount at least 3 lakh, no KYC, device under 10 days old: block all of those.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 300000 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND device.age_days < 10 THEN BLOCK reason="big_unverified_new_device"

prompt: Wallet or UPI, 4 or more failures in 24h, block.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [WALLET, UPI] AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 THEN BLOCK reason="failures_light_methods"

prompt: Utilities payment up to 20000 from a trusted merchant is fine, allow.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND txn.amount <= 20000 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="utility_trusted"

prompt: Cards with amount above 60k, international, and hour between 0 and 4 inclusive: block.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND txn.amount > 60000 AND txn.is_international AND txn.hour >= 0 AND txn.hour <= 4 THEN BLOCK reason="intl_card_overnight"

prompt: Review payments where device age is 0 days.
rule: WHEN device.age_days == 0 THEN REVIEW reason="brand_new_device"

prompt: Gaming + wallet + above 2k: review it.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND txn.method == WALLET AND txn.amount > 2000 THEN REVIEW reason="gaming_wallet"

prompt: Account is under 3 days old, and either rooted or 2 lakh+. Block.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 3 AND (device.is_rooted OR txn.amount >= 200000) THEN BLOCK reason="day_zero_account_risk"

prompt: Not whitelisted and electronics and over 90k → review.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND txn.amount > 90000 THEN REVIEW reason="electronics_untrusted"

prompt: Allow KYC-verified users on whitelisted merchants when device is 365 days or older.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND merchant.whitelisted AND device.age_days >= 365 THEN ALLOW reason="established_trusted"

prompt: Block international payments at 1am to 4am inclusive hours (1 to 4) over 30k.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.hour >= 1 AND txn.hour <= 4 AND txn.amount > 30000 THEN BLOCK reason="intl_night_amount"

prompt: Failed attempts over 10 in 24h or more than 20 payments an hour: block.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 10 OR txn.count_1h > 20 THEN BLOCK reason="bot_like_behaviour"

prompt: Netbanking payments of exactly 100000 or more, review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND txn.amount >= 100000 THEN REVIEW reason="netbanking_big"

prompt: Travel bookings above 5 lakh get blocked unless KYC is verified.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND txn.amount > 500000 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="travel_big_no_kyc"

prompt: Our policy: no payment above 10 lakh goes through automatically, send it to review.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 1000000 THEN REVIEW reason="manual_check_10_lakh"

prompt: Unverified customers can't spend more than ₹25,000 in one payment. Block anything above.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount > 25000 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_cap_25k"

prompt: For gaming merchants, block when the account is under 14 days old.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND user.account_age_days < 14 THEN BLOCK reason="gaming_young_account"

prompt: We want review on any international payment above 50,000 rupees, except when the merchant is whitelisted.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 50000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="intl_untrusted"

prompt: Rooted phones are not permitted on card payments. Block.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.method == CARD THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_card_ban"

prompt: Trusted merchants with KYC-verified customers, amount at most 1 lakh: approve straight away.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount <= 100000 THEN ALLOW reason="trusted_pair_auto"

prompt: Please make sure we block anyone who has failed 6 or more times today.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 6 THEN BLOCK reason="failure_limit"

prompt: If a user makes more than 10 payments within an hour and the amount is above 5000, hold it for review.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 10 AND txn.amount > 5000 THEN REVIEW reason="burst_activity"

prompt: Night rule: between 12 midnight and 5 in the morning (hours 0 to 4), review payments over 20k.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 0 AND txn.hour <= 4 AND txn.amount > 20000 THEN REVIEW reason="night_large"

prompt: Devices seen for less than 7 days, with a payment over ₹50,000, are to be blocked.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 7 AND txn.amount > 50000 THEN BLOCK reason="new_device_50k"

prompt: No auto-approval for travel or gaming. If amount is 30k or more, review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, GAMING] AND txn.amount >= 30000 THEN REVIEW reason="risky_category_30k"

prompt: We should allow UPI payments below Rs 2,000 from established accounts, 180 days or older.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND txn.amount < 2000 AND user.account_age_days >= 180 THEN ALLOW reason="small_upi_established"

prompt: Block electronics purchases above 1.5 lakh when the user has no KYC or the device is under 3 days old.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND txn.amount > 150000 AND (NOT user.kyc_verified OR device.age_days < 3) THEN BLOCK reason="electronics_weak_identity"

prompt: Wallet transactions are capped: over 10k means review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND txn.amount > 10000 THEN REVIEW reason="wallet_cap"

prompt: Review at 22:00 or later for grocery spends above 15k.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 22 AND merchant.category == GROCERY AND txn.amount > 15000 THEN REVIEW reason="late_grocery_large"

prompt: International and not KYC verified, block, no exceptions.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="intl_no_kyc"

prompt: Let utility bills up to 50k through for whitelisted billers.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount <= 50000 THEN ALLOW reason="utility_biller_trusted"

prompt: Anything above 5 lakh on netbanking from an account under 60 days old: block.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 500000 AND txn.method == NETBANKING AND user.account_age_days < 60 THEN BLOCK reason="young_account_netbanking_big"

prompt: Food delivery and grocery under 1,000 rupees from verified users, allow.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [FOOD, GROCERY] AND txn.amount < 1000 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="everyday_small"

prompt: Review when a rooted device is paying a merchant who isn't whitelisted.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_untrusted_merchant"

prompt: Hold any payment from a device with age under 1 day if account is under 1 day too.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 1 AND user.account_age_days < 1 THEN REVIEW reason="both_brand_new"

prompt: Block 3 or more failed attempts combined with international. Also block 3 or more failed attempts with rooted device.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3 AND (txn.is_international OR device.is_rooted) THEN BLOCK reason="failures_plus_risk"

prompt: Cards over 80k at a merchant that isn't trusted, or any amount above 4 lakh: send for review.
rule: WHEN (txn.method == CARD AND txn.amount > 80000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted) OR txn.amount > 400000 THEN REVIEW reason="card_untrusted_or_huge"

prompt: Gaming at hour 23 or later, block.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND txn.hour >= 23 THEN BLOCK reason="gaming_late_night"

prompt: Don't block UPI payments up to 1000 rupees, even in the night. Allow if KYC done.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND txn.amount <= 1000 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="micro_upi_verified"

prompt: Block payments with more than 15 in an hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 15 THEN BLOCK reason="hourly_flood"

prompt: Review travel payments from international sources above 1 lakh.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 100000 THEN REVIEW reason="intl_travel_large"

prompt: New devices (under 5 days) used on accounts under 30 days, with amount above 15k and no KYC, block.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 5 AND user.account_age_days < 30 AND txn.amount > 15000 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="stacked_newness_no_kyc"

prompt: if txn.amount > 2L and merchant not whitelisted, block pls
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 200000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="huge_untrusted"

prompt: add a rule: rooted && upi && hour < 6 -> review
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.method == UPI AND txn.hour < 6 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_upi_early_morning"

prompt: can we block when failed_attempts_24h is more than 7?
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 7 THEN BLOCK reason="failure_threshold"

prompt: quick one: device age < 3 days and count in last hour >= 4, review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 3 AND txn.count_1h >= 4 THEN REVIEW reason="new_device_burst"

prompt: allow if kyc verified and amount <= 5000 and method is UPI.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount <= 5000 AND txn.method == UPI THEN ALLOW reason="verified_small_upi"

prompt: BLOCK: international and amount over 3 lakh.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 300000 THEN BLOCK reason="intl_3_lakh"

prompt: Review all electronics orders over 1L placed with a card by an account under 45 days.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND txn.amount > 100000 AND txn.method == CARD AND user.account_age_days < 45 THEN REVIEW reason="electronics_card_young"

prompt: hey, need a block for netbanking + gaming combo. any amount.
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND merchant.category == GAMING THEN BLOCK reason="netbanking_gaming"

prompt: Rooted or jailbroken device with hour >= 22: block.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.hour >= 22 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_late"

prompt: not whitelisted merchants, wallet payments above 3k, review those
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.method == WALLET AND txn.amount > 3000 THEN REVIEW reason="wallet_untrusted"

prompt: block if count_1h > 12 or failed attempts >= 8
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 12 OR user.failed_attempts_24h >= 8 THEN BLOCK reason="abuse_signals"

prompt: let it through when whitelisted and not international and under 10k
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND NOT txn.is_international AND txn.amount < 10000 THEN ALLOW reason="domestic_trusted_small"

prompt: Grocery, food or utilities with 1 failed attempt or less and amount below 3000 -- approve.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GROCERY, FOOD, UTILITIES] AND user.failed_attempts_24h <= 1 AND txn.amount < 3000 THEN ALLOW reason="routine_low_risk"

prompt: Travel + intl + not kyc → block
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND txn.is_international AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="travel_intl_no_kyc"

prompt: review (device age under 14 days OR account age under 14 days) AND amount over 35k
rule: WHEN (device.age_days < 14 OR user.account_age_days < 14) AND txn.amount > 35000 THEN REVIEW reason="newness_35k"

prompt: Please block any UPI txn where amount is 1 lakh or above and hour is 0-3 (inclusive).
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND txn.amount >= 100000 AND txn.hour >= 0 AND txn.hour <= 3 THEN BLOCK reason="upi_night_big"

prompt: if the user isn't kyc verified and has done more than 3 payments this hour, review
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.count_1h > 3 THEN REVIEW reason="unverified_velocity"

prompt: block card or netbanking when the device is rooted and amount > 15k
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING] AND device.is_rooted AND txn.amount > 15000 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_bank_methods"

prompt: Review payments above ₹8,00,000, no matter what.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 800000 THEN REVIEW reason="very_large_review"

prompt: allow if device is at least 90 days old and account at least 90 days old and kyc ok
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 90 AND user.account_age_days >= 90 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="mature_user_device"

prompt: block gaming when amount is above 5k and the user's failed attempts is 2 or more
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND txn.amount > 5000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 2 THEN BLOCK reason="gaming_failed_attempts"

prompt: review: international OR rooted, but only if not whitelisted
rule: WHEN (txn.is_international OR device.is_rooted) AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="risky_flag_untrusted"

prompt: Block if amount > 50k and (method is wallet or merchant is gaming) and hour < 6.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 50000 AND (txn.method == WALLET OR merchant.category == GAMING) AND txn.hour < 6 THEN BLOCK reason="night_wallet_gaming_large"

prompt: Walk me through a rule for a block when device age == 0 and account age < 2 days and international and amount > 10k.
rule: WHEN device.age_days == 0 AND user.account_age_days < 2 AND txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 10000 THEN BLOCK reason="fresh_everything_intl"

prompt: allow food under 800 rupees if method is UPI or WALLET
rule: WHEN merchant.category == FOOD AND txn.amount < 800 AND txn.method IN [UPI, WALLET] THEN ALLOW reason="small_food_light"

prompt: Just block more than 30 payments an hour, whatever else is true.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 30 THEN BLOCK reason="extreme_velocity"

prompt: review electronics at hour 0 to 5 inclusive
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND txn.hour >= 0 AND txn.hour <= 5 THEN REVIEW reason="electronics_overnight"

prompt: All payments by customers without completed KYC above Rs 50,000 must be blocked.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount > 50000 THEN BLOCK reason="kyc_threshold"

prompt: International payments over ₹2,50,000 need manual review for reporting.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 250000 THEN REVIEW reason="intl_reporting"

prompt: Gaming transactions from accounts without KYC: block, whatever the amount.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="gaming_no_kyc"

prompt: Review any payment of 10 lakh or above on card or netbanking.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 1000000 AND txn.method IN [CARD, NETBANKING] THEN REVIEW reason="big_bank_method"

prompt: Verified customers paying whitelisted utilities, up to 1 lakh, may be allowed.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND merchant.category == UTILITIES AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount <= 100000 THEN ALLOW reason="verified_utility_trusted"

prompt: Accounts less than 24 hours old (account age 0 days) may not make payments over 5000. Block.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days == 0 AND txn.amount > 5000 THEN BLOCK reason="day_zero_cap"

prompt: Where a user has 5 or more failed attempts in a day and is not KYC verified, review.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 5 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN REVIEW reason="failures_no_kyc"

prompt: Block travel transactions above 2 lakh, international, with a non-whitelisted merchant.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND txn.amount > 200000 AND txn.is_international AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="travel_intl_untrusted_large"

prompt: Wallet payments above 20,000 from unverified customers are prohibited.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND txn.amount > 20000 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="wallet_kyc_limit"

prompt: Payments from rooted or jailbroken devices above Rs 1,00,000 to be reviewed.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.amount > 100000 THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_1_lakh"

prompt: Do not approve payments at electronics merchants over 2 lakh unless the merchant is whitelisted and the user is KYC verified. Review them.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND txn.amount > 200000 AND NOT (merchant.whitelisted AND user.kyc_verified) THEN REVIEW reason="electronics_big_unverified"

prompt: Review UPI payments by accounts under 15 days old if the amount exceeds 1 lakh.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND user.account_age_days < 15 AND txn.amount > 100000 THEN REVIEW reason="upi_young_big"

prompt: Block when more than 6 payments occur within an hour and the user is not KYC verified.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 6 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="velocity_no_kyc"

prompt: International payments at gaming merchants are not allowed.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND merchant.category == GAMING THEN BLOCK reason="intl_gaming_ban"

prompt: Allow domestic payments up to ₹15,000 from KYC-verified users on devices older than 30 days.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND txn.amount <= 15000 AND user.kyc_verified AND device.age_days > 30 THEN ALLOW reason="domestic_verified_known_device"

prompt: Anything transacted between 11pm and 6am (hours 23, and 0 through 5) over 75,000 should be reviewed.
rule: WHEN (txn.hour >= 23 OR txn.hour < 6) AND txn.amount > 75000 THEN REVIEW reason="overnight_75k"

prompt: Blocked: card payments, international, from accounts below 10 days.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND txn.is_international AND user.account_age_days < 10 THEN BLOCK reason="intl_card_young_account"

prompt: A transaction is to be blocked if the amount is above 1 lakh and either KYC is incomplete or the device is rooted.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 100000 AND (NOT user.kyc_verified OR device.is_rooted) THEN BLOCK reason="large_weak_identity"

prompt: Netbanking payments to non-whitelisted gaming or travel merchants over 40k go to review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND merchant.category IN [GAMING, TRAVEL] AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount > 40000 THEN REVIEW reason="netbanking_risky_untrusted"

prompt: Block failed-attempt counts above 15 in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 15 THEN BLOCK reason="excessive_failures"

prompt: Review food and grocery payments from international origin above 20k.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [FOOD, GROCERY] AND txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 20000 THEN REVIEW reason="intl_everyday_large"

prompt: Verified users, whitelisted merchants, domestic, any amount up to 5 lakh: permitted.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND merchant.whitelisted AND NOT txn.is_international AND txn.amount <= 500000 THEN ALLOW reason="fully_trusted_domestic"

prompt: Devices under 2 days old are not permitted to pay more than 10,000 on wallet or UPI.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 2 AND txn.amount > 10000 AND txn.method IN [WALLET, UPI] THEN BLOCK reason="new_device_light_method_cap"

prompt: Unverified KYC and rooted device: block, any amount.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="no_kyc_rooted"

prompt: Payments above 3 lakh, excluding whitelisted merchants, require review.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 300000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="large_non_whitelisted"

prompt: Where account age is under 90 days and payment is above 2 lakh, review, but only for travel and electronics.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 90 AND txn.amount > 200000 AND merchant.category IN [TRAVEL, ELECTRONICS] THEN REVIEW reason="young_big_ticket_categories"

prompt: Block payments with 9 or more attempts in the hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 9 THEN BLOCK reason="hourly_attempt_limit"

prompt: customer keeps getting declined, can we auto-block anyone with 4 failed attempts today?
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 THEN BLOCK reason="four_failures"

prompt: If the person is KYC verified and paying under 3000 at a trusted shop, just let it go.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount < 3000 AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="verified_small_trusted"

prompt: Send to review when a brand new account (0 days old) pays above 2000.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days == 0 AND txn.amount > 2000 THEN REVIEW reason="same_day_account"

prompt: Too many complaints about gaming. Review gaming payments over 3,000 on wallet.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND txn.method == WALLET AND txn.amount > 3000 THEN REVIEW reason="gaming_wallet_complaints"

prompt: Block the payment if more than 10 went through in one hour and the device is rooted.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 10 AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_burst"

prompt: Don't hold small UPI payments, anything under ₹300 should go straight through.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND txn.amount < 300 THEN ALLOW reason="tiny_upi"

prompt: Review international payments from users with 2 or more failed attempts.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 2 THEN REVIEW reason="intl_with_failures"

prompt: Customers with phones under 3 days old are getting flagged a lot, so review those above 30k only.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 3 AND txn.amount > 30000 THEN REVIEW reason="new_phone_30k"

prompt: Allow food orders under ₹2,000 if the account is at least 60 days old.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == FOOD AND txn.amount < 2000 AND user.account_age_days >= 60 THEN ALLOW reason="food_established_user"

prompt: Anyone paying a non-trusted merchant above 1 lakh with no KYC: block.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount > 100000 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="untrusted_large_no_kyc"

prompt: Late at night (from 11pm, hour 23) plus international: please review.
rule: WHEN txn.hour == 23 AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="intl_11pm"

prompt: Block electronics orders over 60k when it's a first-day device.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND txn.amount > 60000 AND device.age_days == 0 THEN BLOCK reason="electronics_day_zero_device"

prompt: For utility bill payments, allow up to 10,000 even for unverified users.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND txn.amount <= 10000 THEN ALLOW reason="utility_small_any_user"

prompt: If it's a rooted phone on UPI, review. If it's netbanking on a rooted phone, review too.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.method IN [UPI, NETBANKING] THEN REVIEW reason="rooted_upi_netbanking"

prompt: Block if 12 payments or more in one hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 12 THEN BLOCK reason="twelve_per_hour"

prompt: Travel payments above ₹1,50,000 by users who failed 3+ times: block.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND txn.amount > 150000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3 THEN BLOCK reason="travel_large_failures"

prompt: Review any card payment when the user has no KYC and amount is over 20k.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.amount > 20000 THEN REVIEW reason="card_no_kyc_20k"

prompt: Whitelisted merchant and 0 failed attempts and under 25k? Allow.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 AND txn.amount < 25000 THEN ALLOW reason="clean_trusted_25k"

prompt: Wallet user, account under 20 days, over 5k. Review please.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND user.account_age_days < 20 AND txn.amount > 5000 THEN REVIEW reason="young_wallet_5k"

prompt: Payments of 2 lakh or more after 10pm (22 onwards) should be blocked unless merchant is whitelisted.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 200000 AND txn.hour >= 22 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="late_huge_untrusted"

prompt: Block if device has been seen under 4 days and user failed 3 times or more.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 4 AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3 THEN BLOCK reason="new_device_failures"

prompt: Customer is international, gaming merchant, wallet: review.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND merchant.category == GAMING AND txn.method == WALLET THEN REVIEW reason="intl_gaming_wallet"

prompt: Allow grocery payments any time of day up to ₹6,000 if the user has KYC and zero failures.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GROCERY AND txn.amount <= 6000 AND user.kyc_verified AND user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 THEN ALLOW reason="grocery_clean_verified"

prompt: Hold anything over 4 lakh.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 400000 THEN REVIEW reason="hold_4_lakh"

prompt: Block when amount is above 25k and either the device is under 1 day old or the account is under 1 day old.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 25000 AND (device.age_days < 1 OR user.account_age_days < 1) THEN BLOCK reason="day_one_large"

prompt: Netbanking, 6 in the morning or earlier (hour 0 to 6), amount over 50k: review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND txn.hour <= 6 AND txn.amount > 50000 THEN REVIEW reason="early_netbanking_50k"

prompt: Block everything over 10 lakh. Simple.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 1000000 THEN BLOCK reason="hard_cap_10_lakh"

prompt: Gaming and the person isn't verified, block it.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="gaming_unverified"

prompt: Anyone whose device is rooted, review, I don't care about the amount.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted THEN REVIEW reason="any_rooted"

prompt: Foreign payment, over 1 lakh, new account under 30 days, block it.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 100000 AND user.account_age_days < 30 THEN BLOCK reason="intl_large_young"

prompt: Let our trusted merchants through, under 2 lakh, as long as KYC is done.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount < 200000 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="trusted_merchants_fast_lane"

prompt: More than 5 tries failed in a day? Block.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h > 5 THEN BLOCK reason="failed_over_5"

prompt: Review stuff at 2 or 3 at night above 10k. Hours 2 and 3 only.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 2 AND txn.hour <= 3 AND txn.amount > 10000 THEN REVIEW reason="two_three_am"

prompt: Wallet on gaming sites: block over 5k.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND merchant.category == GAMING AND txn.amount > 5000 THEN BLOCK reason="wallet_gaming_5k"

prompt: Small UPI, up to 500, always allow.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND txn.amount <= 500 THEN ALLOW reason="always_small_upi"

prompt: Block unless verified: travel over 1 lakh.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND txn.amount > 100000 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="travel_unverified_large"

prompt: Fresh devices, under 2 days, with big ticket 1 lakh and up on electronics: review.
rule: WHEN device.age_days < 2 AND txn.amount >= 100000 AND merchant.category == ELECTRONICS THEN REVIEW reason="fresh_device_electronics_big"

prompt: If someone does 7 or more payments in an hour, block, or if they've failed 5 times.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 7 OR user.failed_attempts_24h >= 5 THEN BLOCK reason="velocity_or_failures"

prompt: Netbanking over 3 lakh: review. Card over 3 lakh: review.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [NETBANKING, CARD] AND txn.amount > 300000 THEN REVIEW reason="bank_methods_3_lakh"

prompt: Account under a week old, rooted phone: block.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 7 AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="week_old_rooted"

prompt: Approve grocery and food from whitelisted merchants under 8k.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [GROCERY, FOOD] AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount < 8000 THEN ALLOW reason="trusted_everyday_8k"

prompt: Late night, 12 to 4 am (hours 0 through 3), international, review.
rule: WHEN txn.hour >= 0 AND txn.hour <= 3 AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="intl_late_night"

prompt: Stop utility payments over 2 lakh from non-whitelisted merchants.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND txn.amount > 200000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="utility_big_untrusted"

prompt: Amount above 75k and no KYC and wallet: block block block.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 75000 AND NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.method == WALLET THEN BLOCK reason="wallet_big_no_kyc"

prompt: Old devices, 1 year plus, and old accounts, 1 year plus, are good. Allow under 1 lakh.
rule: WHEN device.age_days >= 365 AND user.account_age_days >= 365 AND txn.amount < 100000 THEN ALLOW reason="veteran_users"

prompt: Check payments over 50k where the account is under 10 days old or the user has 3 failures.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 50000 AND (user.account_age_days < 10 OR user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3) THEN REVIEW reason="large_newish_or_failing"

prompt: International, not trusted merchant, 20k or more, rooted: block.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount >= 20000 AND device.is_rooted THEN BLOCK reason="intl_untrusted_rooted"

prompt: Electronics, travel, gaming = risky. Over 1 lakh on any of them with a new device under 10 days: review.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [ELECTRONICS, TRAVEL, GAMING] AND txn.amount > 100000 AND device.age_days < 10 THEN REVIEW reason="risky_category_new_device"

prompt: Block 25+ payments an hour.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 25 THEN BLOCK reason="crazy_velocity"

prompt: Under 1 lakh, domestic, and trusted merchant: allow no matter the hour.
rule: WHEN txn.amount < 100000 AND NOT txn.is_international AND merchant.whitelisted THEN ALLOW reason="domestic_trusted_any_hour"

prompt: Block UPI between 1am and 5am (hours 1 to 5) if amount more than 50k and device less than 7 days old.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND txn.hour >= 1 AND txn.hour <= 5 AND txn.amount > 50000 AND device.age_days < 7 THEN BLOCK reason="upi_night_new_device"

prompt: Review the user if failed attempts are 2 or more and they are paying on netbanking.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 2 AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN REVIEW reason="netbanking_after_failures"

prompt: Block card, 90k plus, from a device under 3 days old, with an unverified user.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND txn.amount >= 90000 AND device.age_days < 3 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="card_big_new_device_no_kyc"

prompt: Please block the payment when amount is more than 1 lakh and user have no KYC.
rule: WHEN txn.amount > 100000 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="large_no_kyc"

prompt: If device is rooted and payment is by card, please block.
rule: WHEN device.is_rooted AND txn.method == CARD THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_card"

prompt: Review the transactions of gaming merchant when amount is above 4000.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND txn.amount > 4000 THEN REVIEW reason="gaming_4k"

prompt: User who failed login 5 times or more in one day, we should block his payment.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 5 THEN BLOCK reason="five_failures_day"

prompt: Allow the payment if merchant is on trusted list and amount is below 10000 rupees.
rule: WHEN merchant.whitelisted AND txn.amount < 10000 THEN ALLOW reason="trusted_under_10k"

prompt: For international payment, if account is less than 15 days old, please do review.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND user.account_age_days < 15 THEN REVIEW reason="intl_young_account"

prompt: Block when the hour is before 4 in the morning and amount more than 30 thousand.
rule: WHEN txn.hour < 4 AND txn.amount > 30000 THEN BLOCK reason="very_early_30k"

prompt: Wallet payment above 15000 rupees with new device less than 5 days: review it.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND txn.amount > 15000 AND device.age_days < 5 THEN REVIEW reason="wallet_new_device"

prompt: Please allow UPI payment to grocery merchant if amount is under 2000 and user is KYC verified.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND merchant.category == GROCERY AND txn.amount < 2000 AND user.kyc_verified THEN ALLOW reason="upi_grocery_small_verified"

prompt: Payment of travel category above 2 lakh must be blocked if merchant is not trusted.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == TRAVEL AND txn.amount > 200000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="travel_untrusted_2_lakh"

prompt: More than 10 payment in one hour is suspicious, block.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h > 10 THEN BLOCK reason="too_many_in_hour"

prompt: If user is not verified in KYC, and payment is international, we want review.
rule: WHEN NOT user.kyc_verified AND txn.is_international THEN REVIEW reason="intl_unverified"

prompt: Block electronics payment of 1.5L or more by netbanking.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == ELECTRONICS AND txn.amount >= 150000 AND txn.method == NETBANKING THEN BLOCK reason="electronics_netbanking_big"

prompt: Review please: device age is 0 days and amount above 5000.
rule: WHEN device.age_days == 0 AND txn.amount > 5000 THEN REVIEW reason="new_device_5k"

prompt: Payment from device that is rooted or user that failed 3 times, and amount above 20000, should be blocked.
rule: WHEN (device.is_rooted OR user.failed_attempts_24h >= 3) AND txn.amount > 20000 THEN BLOCK reason="rooted_or_failing_20k"

prompt: Allow for food and utilities when user has account older than 100 days and amount is under 5000.
rule: WHEN merchant.category IN [FOOD, UTILITIES] AND user.account_age_days > 100 AND txn.amount < 5000 THEN ALLOW reason="food_utility_old_account"

prompt: For card payment at 11pm or later, amount more than 25k, give review.
rule: WHEN txn.method == CARD AND txn.hour >= 23 AND txn.amount > 25000 THEN REVIEW reason="card_late_25k"

prompt: Block if account is new, less than 5 days, and also device is new, less than 5 days.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 5 AND device.age_days < 5 THEN BLOCK reason="both_under_5_days"

prompt: Merchant not on trusted list and payment from rooted device, and amount above 10k, block it.
rule: WHEN NOT merchant.whitelisted AND device.is_rooted AND txn.amount > 10000 THEN BLOCK reason="untrusted_rooted_10k"

prompt: Wallet or UPI payments international: review it, amount above 5000.
rule: WHEN txn.method IN [WALLET, UPI] AND txn.is_international AND txn.amount > 5000 THEN REVIEW reason="intl_light_methods"

prompt: When amount is 5 lakh or more, send to review, except trusted merchants.
rule: WHEN txn.amount >= 500000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN REVIEW reason="huge_untrusted_review"

prompt: Block user who made 6 or more payments in the last hour and has no KYC.
rule: WHEN txn.count_1h >= 6 AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="burst_no_kyc"

prompt: Gaming merchant and hour between 0 and 5 inclusive: block the payment.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND txn.hour >= 0 AND txn.hour <= 5 THEN BLOCK reason="gaming_overnight"

prompt: Please allow the payment for utilities if the amount is not more than 3000 and failed attempts is zero.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == UTILITIES AND txn.amount <= 3000 AND user.failed_attempts_24h == 0 THEN ALLOW reason="utility_small_clean"

prompt: Food merchant and device rooted and amount more than 8k, review this.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == FOOD AND device.is_rooted AND txn.amount > 8000 THEN REVIEW reason="food_rooted_8k"

prompt: If international and netbanking and 50k above, we block.
rule: WHEN txn.is_international AND txn.method == NETBANKING AND txn.amount > 50000 THEN BLOCK reason="intl_netbanking_50k"

prompt: Account less than 2 days, amount over 15000, not trusted merchant, and not KYC. Block all.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days < 2 AND txn.amount > 15000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted AND NOT user.kyc_verified THEN BLOCK reason="day_one_untrusted_no_kyc"

prompt: Review UPI where device age under 3 days and 4 or more failed attempts.
rule: WHEN txn.method == UPI AND device.age_days < 3 AND user.failed_attempts_24h >= 4 THEN REVIEW reason="upi_new_device_failures"

prompt: Allow payment when user is verified, merchant is food or grocery, and amount below 4000.
rule: WHEN user.kyc_verified AND merchant.category IN [FOOD, GROCERY] AND txn.amount < 4000 THEN ALLOW reason="verified_food_grocery"

prompt: Wallet payment, up to 1000 rupees, device older than 60 days: allow.
rule: WHEN txn.method == WALLET AND txn.amount <= 1000 AND device.age_days > 60 THEN ALLOW reason="small_wallet_known_device"

prompt: Not international, whitelisted merchant, zero payments before in this hour (count 0), allow up to 50000.
rule: WHEN NOT txn.is_international AND merchant.whitelisted AND txn.count_1h == 0 AND txn.amount <= 50000 THEN ALLOW reason="first_payment_trusted"

prompt: Account older than 2 years (730 days), allow card payment under 30000.
rule: WHEN user.account_age_days > 730 AND txn.method == CARD AND txn.amount < 30000 THEN ALLOW reason="old_account_card"

prompt: Block payment if user fail 20 times or more in 24 hours.
rule: WHEN user.failed_attempts_24h >= 20 THEN BLOCK reason="twenty_failures"

prompt: Netbanking payment from rooted device or from device under 1 day: block it.
rule: WHEN txn.method == NETBANKING AND (device.is_rooted OR device.age_days < 1) THEN BLOCK reason="netbanking_risky_device"

prompt: Block gaming payment above 1 lakh if the merchant is not trusted.
rule: WHEN merchant.category == GAMING AND txn.amount > 100000 AND NOT merchant.whitelisted THEN BLOCK reason="gaming_large_untrusted"
